# Microsoft Voice Principles For Study Plans

## Voice goals

- Warm and relaxed: confidence-building and non-judgmental.
- Crisp and clear: scannable sections and short bullets.
- Ready to lend a hand: clear next action for every recommendation.

## Study-plan writing standards

- Use sentence-style capitalization.
- Keep objective text accurate and current.
- Use direct language and active voice.
- Avoid contractions in exam-prep content.
- Keep effort estimates realistic and transparent.
